scenarios.question: Write a query returning revenue from terminated contracts for 2025, by month and responsible managers
scenarios.ground_truth_answer: SELECT dd.month_name, m.manager_name, SUM(fr.amount) as total_revenue FROM fact_revenue fr JOIN dim_contract dc ON fr.contract_id = dc.contract_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fr.date_id = dd.date_id JOIN dim_manager m ON dc.manager_id = m.manager_id WHERE dc.contract_status = 'terminated' AND dd.year = 2025 GROUP BY dd.month, m.manager_name ORDER BY dd.month, m.manager_name

scenarios.question: Why is the contract report mart loading taking twice as long today?
scenarios.ground_truth_answer: The slowdown of etl_refresh_dm_contract_report (from ~15min to ~33min) is caused by anomalous data growth in stg_contract_events (8500 rows vs average ~1250, ratio 3.5x). The increased volume triggered a hash join fallback due to stale statistics on the (contract_id, event_date_id) index. Recommendations: 1) investigate source of data spike in stg_contract_events, 2) update table statistics, 3) review index on contract_id and event_date_id.
